claim: In a unanimous per curiam decision on October 18, 2021, the Court reversed the Ninth Circuit and granted immunity to a Union City officer who briefly placed his knee on the back of an armed suspect, finding the sole cited precedent "materially distinguishable."
evidence: These facts, considered together in the context of this particular arrest, materially distinguish this case from LaLonde.
